Wavelength λ = 299.8 / f, with f in MHz and λ in metres.

Boom length = A + both overhangs. Tube span = center tube + 2 × (intermediate tube + end tube − both insertions). For the author’s feeds, T = A + 2Δ and D = λ × VF / 8. Use millimetres throughout. R = (T + D) / 2, S = (T − D) / 2.
Boom length = A + both overhangs. Each end section = (element span − center tube length) / 2 + insertion. R branch = F, S branch = E − F. E and F come from the published table.

Insertion = (center tube + 2 × end tube − assembled span) / 2. For an initial geometry estimate at other frequencies DK7ZB gives R ≈ 150 / f, S ≈ 139 / f, A ≈ λ / 8, RS ≈ 0.076λ, SS ≈ 0.072λ, with lengths in metres. This profile uses the published 6 m dimensions.
Cut length = finished rod length − the length added by its end fitting.
Each half of the copper tube is 260 / 2 = 130 mm before assembly. Mark the 250 mm center spacing after inserting the tubes in the tee.
Cutting lengths come from the published drawing. Follow the specified assembly dimensions for this build.
